import csv

cool_id = "c9fc3c98-8ad8-5bba-a072-0a5c02357f48"
heat_id = "dcb57f97-6711-5249-9f6f-3a81a69fc8d6"
temp_id = "c49bbc2f-096e-5e16-bead-066250790308"

data = {cool_id: {}, heat_id: {}, temp_id: {}}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        tid = row["timeseries_id"]
        if tid in data:
            data[tid][row["timestamp"]] = float(row["value"])

date = "2018-07-04"
all_ok = True
bad = []
for ts in sorted(data[temp_id]):
    if ts.startswith(date):
        t = data[temp_id][ts]
        c = data[cool_id].get(ts)
        h = data[heat_id].get(ts)
        if c is None or h is None:
            bad.append((ts, t, h, c, "missing setpoint"))
            continue
        # in-range: t >= h and t <= c
        if not (h <= t <= c):
            bad.append((ts, t, h, c, "out of range"))

print("num bad:", len(bad))
for b in bad[:15]:
    print(b)
print("all_ok (no bad):", all_ok)
